answer: Shards are assigned from the hollow graph, and as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The signal assignment is published and thread records each panel. The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 1975 identities would post 3956 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
